teamDetailedDescription: Hello! I am Md. Nafizur Rahman, a dedicated Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) student at the Department of Veterinary and Animal Sciences, University of Rajshahi, Bangladesh. My academic journey is built upon a strong foundation in Anatomy, Histology, Physiology, Pathology, Parasitology, Microbiology, Medicine, Surgery, Epidemiology, and Public Health. I am deeply passionate about bridging the gap between biological research and advanced computational science to improve animal welfare, public health, and disease prevention. Throughout my journey, I have integrated traditional veterinary science with modern Data Analytics, developing proficiency in Python, SQL, and data visualization tools like GeoPandas and Matplotlib to drive evidence-based research. My research experience and focus areas include: Clinical Surveillance & Antimicrobial Stewardship, Nanomedicine & Computational Biology, Epidemiology & Parasitology, Water Quality & Livestock Health, Socio-Veterinary Studies, Wildlife Rescue & Clinical Service. I am eager to connect with professionals and researchers in the veterinary, nanomedicine, and public health sectors to continue learning and contributing to innovative, evidence-based solutions in disease prevention.

privacyPolicyContent.title: Privacy & Security
privacyPolicyContent.subtitle: PoultryMedix: Privacy, Security, and Terms of Use Policy

sections.heading: 1. App Ownership and Intellectual Property
sections.body: PoultryMedix is an independent digital veterinary health platform integrating modern data analytics with poultry medicine. All intellectual property, algorithms, and design are protected under applicable copyright laws.

sections.heading: 2. Medical Disclaimer & Telemedicine Ethics
bullets: Not a Substitute for Clinical Diagnosis: Smart Diagnosis provides preliminary triage guidance and never replaces an in-person veterinary examination.

Prescription & Treatment: In compliance with the Bangladesh Veterinary Council (BVC) and international telehealth standards, final prescriptions and antimicrobial usage must be authorized by a registered veterinarian.
Dose & Withdrawal Safety: Always verify drug doses, meat withdrawal days, and egg withdrawal periods against approved labels and local veterinary authority regulations.

sections.heading: 3. Data Collection and Informed Consent
bullets: Farm & Flock Information: District/upazila location (for outbreak tracking), flock species, bird count, and reported symptoms.
Media Inputs: Uploaded flock photos, respiratory audio notes, and prescription files used during AI triage and analysis.
Profile Preferences: Selected role (Farmer, Vet Student, or Registered Veterinarian) to tailor workspace tools.

sections.heading: 4. Academic Research & One Health Stewardship
bullets: Research Consent: Anonymized clinical and antibiotic surveillance records contribute to epidemiological research and antimicrobial stewardship.
Anonymity: De-identified data only; personal farmer details are never published or sold to pharmaceutical or marketing parties.

sections.heading: 5. Privacy, Data Security, and Storage
bullets: Encrypted Channels: Data transfers use HTTPS encryption, with local device storage for offline flock, shed, and vaccine tracking.
Third-Party APIs: Weather and map tile providers receive only the minimum geographic coordinates needed to render local weather and maps.

sections.heading: 6. User Rights and Policy Updates
sections.body: You may request deletion of personal profile data at any time. Previously de-identified aggregate statistics remain part of epidemiological summaries. Significant updates are communicated directly through the dashboard.
